subject: ConditionalPanel doesnt work with dynamic controls

messages.author: 12ba4fcf8526f1d6
messages.subject: ConditionalPanel doesnt work with dynamic controls
parts:
I have two tabs and the sidebar contents have to change when one changes the tab. Static Controls change when we switch tabs, but the controls which are created using renderUI in tab1 doesnt disappear when tab2 is selected. Controls in tab2  are also created dynamically on an actionButton click in tab1. When we switch back to tab1, tab1 is fine, it has only its controls.

ActionButton Code:

observe({

     x1<-initiate(feed,input$varPredict,datecol,input$varExo,input$varMiss,session$varColCountry,session$varColSegment) 


     PlotControls(x1,input$varColCountry,input$varColSegment)
    
    
  })


PlotControls<-function(x1,varColCountry,varColSegment)({

    output$country <- renderUI({

      if (is.null(x1)) { return() }
      if (identical(x1, '') || identical(x1,data.frame()) || is.null(x1) ) return(NULL)

      # Variable selection: Country for Plot
      selectInput("varCountry", unique(x1[,varColCountry]), multiple = FALSE,selected=isolate(input$varCountry) )
    })
    
    
    output$segment <- renderUI({
      
      if (is.null(x1)) { return() }
      if (identical(x1, '') || identical(x1,data.frame()) || is.null(x1) ) return(NULL)
      
      # Variable selection:  Segment for Plot
      selectInput("varSegment", unique(x1[,varColSegment]), multiple = FALSE,selected=isolate(input$varSegment) )
    })
})

parts:
If I am not wrong you wanted to show the components encompassed in your first conditionalPanel(...) when tab1 is showing and show the other components for var1 and var when tab 2 is selected.

A few questions 
  • How is input.tab1 defined? Is there a input$tab1 component? I tried this but I don't think Shiny defines input$tab or input$tab1 or anything like it automatically when you create tabs with the tabsetPanel functions. So unless you defined those variables somewhere chances are this just won't work.
  • Also your first conditionalPanel(...) code did not encompass the htmlOutput("var1"). 
  • Also htmlOuput("var1") appeared twice.
  • If possible show us the full server.R and ui.R code (preferably using gist.github.com). It's hard to diagnose without seeing them. Also if it's due a misunderstand of the way Shiny works it's hard to explain the concepts without understanding how you might be understanding Shiny.

On Monday, September 23, 2013 1:00:54 PM UTC+8, Prasanth Rajendiran wrote:
Sorry for not stating the issue clearly. 

Dataframe x1 gets created on action button click in tab1. When i change to tab2, sidepanel html controls have to change. I have done that through conditional panel.

sidebarPanel(
    conditionalPanel("input.tab1==1",

On Monday, September 23, 2013 10:13:26 AM UTC+5:30, ZJ wrote:
I believe neither of your outputs will reactive to changes in x1. For the outputs to reactive your x1 needs to be defined defined by x1 <- reactive(...) type expressions.

On Friday, September 20, 2013 10:40:29 PM UTC+8, Prasanth Rajendiran wrote:
I have two tabs and the sidebar contents have to change when one changes the tab. Static Controls change when we switch tabs, but the controls which are created using renderUI in tab1 doesnt disappear when tab2 is selected. Controls in tab2  are also created dynamically on an actionButton click in tab1. When we switch back to tab1, tab1 is fine, it has only its controls.

ActionButton Code:

observe({

     x1<-initiate(feed,input$varPredict,datecol,input$varExo,input$varMiss,session$varColCountry,session$varColSegment) 


     PlotControls(x1,input$varColCountry,input$varColSegment)
    
    
  })


PlotControls<-function(x1,varColCountry,varColSegment)({

    output$country <- renderUI({

      if (is.null(x1)) { return() }
      if (identical(x1, '') || identical(x1,data.frame()) || is.null(x1) ) return(NULL)

      # Variable selection: Country for Plot
      selectInput("varCountry", unique(x1[,varColCountry]), multiple = FALSE,selected=isolate(input$varCountry) )
    })
    
    
    output$segment <- renderUI({
      
      if (is.null(x1)) { return() }
      if (identical(x1, '') || identical(x1,data.frame()) || is.null(x1) ) return(NULL)
      
      # Variable selection:  Segment for Plot
      selectInput("varSegment", unique(x1[,varColSegment]), multiple = FALSE,selected=isolate(input$varSegment) )
    })
})
